mapper.sql: select c.shop_code, c.categorycode, c.categoryname, c.parentcode, c.ordernum, c.status, c.remark, c.createuser, c.createtime, c.updateuser, c.updatetime, (select count(1) from sdsshop.u_m_waregoods g where g.shop_code = c.shop_code and trim(g.category) = c.categoryname) as goodscount from sdsshop.u_m_goodscategory c
mapper.select: select max(categorycode) from sdsshop.u_m_goodscategory where shop_code = #{shopCode}
mapper.insert: insert into sdsshop.u_m_goodscategory( shop_code, categorycode, categoryname, parentcode, ordernum, status, remark, createuser, createtime ) values( #{shopCode}, #{categoryCode}, #{categoryName}, #{parentCode}, #{orderNum}, #{status}, #{remark}, #{createUser}, sysdate() )
mapper.update: update sdsshop.u_m_goodscategory set categoryname = #{categoryName}, parentcode = #{parentCode}, ordernum = #{orderNum}, status = #{status}, remark = #{remark}, updateuser = #{updateUser}, updatetime = sysdate() where shop_code = #{shopCode} and categorycode = #{categoryCode}
